issue.title: Unspecified exception should not be confused with `dependent_sender_error`

discussion.p: specifies that when completion signatures are not valid an exception of "unspecified class type Except" is thrown. However, this does not prevent Except from being dependent_sender_error, or from being publicly and unambiguously derived from dependent_sender_error. In either case, the handler in would interpret the exception as indicating that the sender is dependent, rather than that its completion signatures are invalid for the given cv- and/or ref-qualification and/or environment.
Tim Song has pointed out that wording technology already exists to solve this (): unspecified-exception.

blockquote.p: Let except be an rvalue subexpression of an unspecified class type Except such that move_constructible<Except> && derived_from<Except, exception> is true. Let CHECKED-COMPLSIGS(e) be e if e is a core constant expression whose type satisfies valid-completion-signatures; otherwise, it is the following expression:
